routers.title: Weather
routers.description: Forecasts and current conditions for any city. Use it for weather questions only.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.title: Get forecast
tools.description: Get the hourly forecast for a city for the next 1-7 days, in metric units. Returns one entry per hour with temperature, rain chance, and wind speed.

city.description: City name, optionally with a country code, such as 'Oslo, NO'.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.title: Get current conditions
tools.description: Get the current temperature, humidity, and wind for a city. Use get_forecast for anything later than the next hour.

city.description: City name, optionally with a country code.
